title: Bitcoin Falls Below $80,000, Down 5% Over Past 24 Hours
text: Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) experienced a significant drop, falling below the $80,000 mark on Saturday. This sharp decline has triggered a widespread crash in the cryptocurrency market. On January 31, Bitcoin’s value plummeted by 5% within a span of 24 hours, trading at $78,479.21. This downfall had a domino effect on other cryptocurrencies as well.
